name: Andreas Schieder - Après le § 58 - Am 11
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Albania
part_text: 58a. Calls on all political actors in Albania to unequivocally reject any form of historical revisionism or territorial claims against neighbouring countries; underlines that good neighbourly relations must be grounded in the inviolability of borders and in mutual respect;
